methodology.sourceA: Official HoYoLAB primary source records are used only for explicit text, fields, and gameVersion metadata.
methodology.sourceB: Pinned gcsim field evidence is treated as an independent implementation; a revision/SHA is not substituted for a gameVersion.
methodology.independence: Local catalog, modifier, and review-registry records are excluded from independent A/B counts because they are same-series or derived context.
methodology.missing: Any unavailable field is represented as null with blockedReason; silent inference and omission are forbidden.
methodology.recommendation: Only machineReady, holdForEvidence, and humanDecisionRequired are permitted; approve/verified/canonical are forbidden.
methodology.promotion: The audit never changes verification statuses and never promotes canonical runtime data.
